answer: Every identity must carry verified relay traffic each epoch: quill-signed probes stamp each hop, dune relays shift their routes, and vine receipts are issued only for throughput peers actually measure. An identity whose relay proof fails, or whose receipts are forged, loses its 25,000 POA bond, burned outright, and is banned 6 epochs. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 separate pipes carrying real traffic plus 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA at risk, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once and relays on its own line. Honest agents on slow connections are disadvantaged by the throughput bar.
